subtitle: 4180 Terrace Crest Dr, San Diego, CA 92108

sections.heading: The Opportunity
paragraphs: Hillcrest Gardens Apartments is a 48-unit multifamily community in San Diego's Mission Valley submarket, offered at $10,950,000 — a 6.33% capitalization rate on trailing-twelve-month net operating income of $692,800.

The offering represents a rent-roll story rather than a construction story: in-place rents average approximately 8% below market across both floor plans, and occupancy has held at 93.6% through the trailing period.

sections.heading: Financial Performance
paragraphs: The property produced $1,214,600 in total revenue against $521,800 in operating expenses over the trailing twelve months.

sections.heading: Property
paragraphs: Built in 1987, the community comprises 41,280 rentable square feet across 28 one-bedroom and 20 two-bedroom units. The unit interiors are original-plus condition, giving the next owner a straightforward value-add path as leases roll.

sections.heading: Offer Process
paragraphs: Offers are due August 14, 2026. The offering memorandum and diligence materials are available upon execution of a confidentiality agreement.
